verdicts.why: The check rejects absent or multiple review sections, an invalid marker, unknown, missing, or duplicate categories, invalid outcomes, unresolved references, APPLICABLE records lacking a State 0–2 decision reference, and every UNRESOLVED outcome. Error findings make the command fail.
